basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Platform Engineer | Production Multi-Agent Systems | Evals, Governance & MCP Author
basics.summary: AI Platform Engineer who ships the execution layer: production multi-agent runtime, evals gate, governance in code, and every prompt/tool call/decision logged for reconstruction. At LumApps I built the platform Sales and RevOps depend on daily: multi-agent workflows on Python and GCP Vertex AI, tools exposed over MCP servers I authored, temporal knowledge graph grounding, verification loops, cost-per-request instrumentation, and on-call for global production. Public work on agent reliability (TowardsAI, blog, 4 conference talks), 3 AI products founded solo through Anand Creations. Comfortable being the only engineer on a platform and closing architecture decisions rather than routing them.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped the production multi-agent platform Sales and RevOps depend on daily. Python on GCP Vertex AI, LangGraph + Google ADK runtime, tools over MCP servers I authored, agent state streamed over AG-UI. Durable state, verification loops, HITL gates before any external write. 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly. Has operational history, real users, and incidents I can talk through.

Own the evaluation layer: golden suites with behavioral assertions, judge rubrics, safety cases per agent, cost-per-request instrumentation, and LangSmith tracing so every run reconstructs from its log. No agent ships without evals; regressions block merge.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j unifying 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one auditable time-aware store. Least-privilege tool grants per agent, decision audit log, and API design that makes the forbidden write structurally impossible, not merely discouraged.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated; own the queue, retries, and provenance log so every translation is reconstructible.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist and a GenAI demo generator: internal LLM-powered tools with governance built in (safe prompts, HITL review of every generated asset before send).

Architected Employee Referral System end to end. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Internal platform non-engineers (recruiters, HR) adopted voluntarily because the reports were useful and the contact was rare.
Ran observability and global on-call (K8s, AWS, Terraform, Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io). Provisioned, deployed, and rolled back production systems end to end.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at an autonomous drone startup. Sole engineer on the platform: full-stack (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL), real-time control APIs, cloud infra on AWS + Docker + Terraform from scratch. 500+ deliveries, 99.5% safety record.
Closed every architecture decision solo. Instrumented flight ops end to end so any incident could be reconstructed from logs.
